findings.problem: The proof that scaling an immersion G by r ≠ 0 keeps `mfderiv (r • G) p` injective is copied verbatim in four theorems. It takes the smoothness of G to get `const_smul_mfderiv`, applies r⁻¹ to the equality, normalises with `smul_smul`/`inv_mul_cancel₀`/`one_smul`, then applies injectivity of `mfderiv G`. The copies are in `uniform_starting_family` (UniformStartingFamily.lean 60-68), `SmallMetricStartingFamily.lean` 43-51, `ReferenceStartingFamily.lean` 54-62 and this file. Each copy has the same `change ... at he` bookkeeping. The statement has nothing to do with the surrounding metric/second-form arguments, so any fix to the elaboration workarounds must be made in four places.
findings.proposed_change:
In UniformStartingFamily.lean, next to `PreferredNormal.const_smul` (namespace ClosedSurfaceR4, which already has `[ChartedSpace Plane M]`), add:

lemma injective_mfderiv_const_smul {F : M → Space}
    (hF : ContMDiff planeModel spaceModel ∞ F) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hinj : ∀ p, Function.Injective (mfderiv planeModel spaceModel F p)) :
    ∀ p, Function.Injective (mfderiv planeModel spaceModel (r • F) p) := by
  intro p v w h
  have hd := const_smul_mfderiv ((hF p).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)) r
  have he := congrArg (fun z : Space => r⁻¹ • z) h
  rw [hd] at he
  change r⁻¹ • (r • (mfderiv planeModel spaceModel F p v)) =
    r⁻¹ • (r • (mfderiv planeModel spaceModel F p w)) at he
  simp only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr, one_smul] at he
  exact hinj p he

This is the existing block with `G`→`F`, `hGI`→`hinj` and `hr.ne'`→`hr`. Then in this file replace lines 45-53 with `have hscaled := injective_mfderiv_const_smul hG hr.ne' hGI`. Make the same one-line replacement in the other three files. In each file the hypotheses `hG : ContMDiff … G`, `hr : 0 < r` and `hGI : ∀ p, Injective (mfderiv … G p)` are already in scope, and the final `exact ⟨a,G,n,ha,hG,hu,hscaled,rfl,…⟩` is unchanged. Nothing new is imported, because all four files import UniformStartingFamily transitively.
findings.benefit: Removes about 36 lines of identical proof from four theorems and gives the fact a name next to `PreferredNormal.const_smul`, the other scaled-immersion fact. Each main theorem then reads as: choose the prepared G, scale it, and quote the bounds. A future change to the `mfderiv` coercions or the smul normalisation is made once.
